object: earthworm-inspired lubricant self-pumping hydrogel surface
problem: How to sustain superlubricity of hydrogels at high contact pressure with limited lubricant volume
mechanism_or_method: Wrinkled dissociated double-network lubrication layer with laser-etched gland-like pores that store and self-pump lubricant during shear

decision_relevance: Guides choice of textured hydrogel coatings for high-load water-lubricated contacts

object: self-healing borate ester poly(methacrylamide) hydrogels
problem: How to combine rapid room-temperature self-healing with high strength in hydrogels
mechanism_or_method: Salt-fusion converts fractures to viscous liquid for healing, then salt-concretion toughens via dynamic borate ester bonds

decision_relevance: Informs repairable wear-resistant and damping material selection

object: dynamic omniphobic coatings for refrigerant condensation
problem: How to achieve stable dropwise condensation of completely wetting low-surface-tension refrigerants
mechanism_or_method: Structure-less dynamic omniphobic P-HFDS coating that keeps low contact angle hysteresis for fluids like ethanol, pentane and R1233zd(E)

object: sp-hybridized graphdiyne for mercury vapor capture
problem: How to capture mercury vapor efficiently with a regenerable carbon material
mechanism_or_method: Accessible sp carbons anchor Hg atoms and drive in-situ adsorption-coupled oxidation via surface charge heterogeneity

object: magnetic microgel particle swarms for bronchial delivery
problem: How to navigate and deliver therapeutics to deep tortuous bronchi in a targeted way

limitation: Preclinical phantom and animal tests; human translation and swarm retrieval not addressed

object: China steel industry CCUS deployment pathways
problem: How to plan CCUS deployment in China's steel sector without overestimating mitigation and costs
mechanism_or_method: Soft-link industry decarbonization pathway model with emission source-sink matching optimization across three scenarios

object: lattice-based musculoskeletal soft-rigid robots
problem: How to program stiffness and anisotropy continuously in single-material soft-rigid robotic structures
mechanism_or_method: Continuous blending and superposition of lattice unit-cell geometries to tune stiffness, applied to a tendon-driven robotic elephant

object: origami exoskeletons for soft robotic arms

mechanism_or_method: Shrimp-inspired multistable origami exoskeleton with flexible-rigid arrangement giving high stiffness and long-stroke transitions

object: structures in California WUI wildfires

mechanism_or_method: XGBoost classifier on post-fire inspection, remote sensing and fire reconstruction data from five major California fires

object: photodegradable silicone elastomer soft robots

object: AuCu random solid-solution alloy nanowires

object: Western U.S. power system resource adequacy
problem: Which meteorological patterns drive resource adequacy failures as wind and solar penetration rises

object: Janus adhesive hydrogels

object: temperature-responsive multimaterial soft metamaterials
problem: How to design structures with programmable temperature-switchable nonlinear mechanical responses
mechanism_or_method: Computational morphogenesis plus multimaterial 3D printing exploiting distinct polymer glass transition temperatures

object: frictional interface slip during stick-slip
problem: How does slip evolve after rupture initiates frictional motion, beyond continuous dynamic friction

object: spent Li- and Mn-rich layered oxide cathodes

object: nematic liquid crystal cells with moire anchoring patterns
problem: How to engineer tunable topological defects in nematic liquid crystals

object: 2D van der Waals alkylammonium halide barocaloric materials
problem: How to get reversible colossal barocaloric effect at low pressure with small hysteresis
mechanism_or_method: Long carbon chains form 2D layered plastic crystals whose anisotropic expansion enables chain conformational disordering

object: ultrathin organosiloxane nanofiltration membrane
problem: How to achieve precise molecular sieving of small solutes in organic solvents

object: high-entropy metallic glasses

object: heliostats in concentrating solar power plants

object: millimeter-scale magnetic soft capsules for liquid sampling
problem: How to sample liquids in tortuous fluid-filled confined body spaces minimally invasively

object: micro-robot building blocks for reconfigurable smart materials
problem: How to control matter at the building-block level to get reconfigurable multifunctional materials

object: mechano-adaptive metamaterial hydrogels

object: additively manufactured Fe-Co-Ni soft-magnetic medium-entropy alloy

object: polyolefin reweaved ultra-micropore gas separation membranes

object: coalescing condensate microdroplets on nanostructured superhydrophobic surfaces

object: twist-hyperbolic metamaterial with TENG for UAV impact protection

object: switchable wrinkled hydrogel film tissue adhesive

object: shape-memory polymer optical fibers
problem: How to make light-guiding fibers that switch between programmed shapes

object: cerium-doped zirconia shape memory ceramics in aluminum matrix

object: Sigma9 grain boundary in Fe-3%Si bcc crystal

object: metallic glass potential energy landscape

object: adhesion hysteresis of soft elastic contacts

object: Noto Peninsula earthquake swarm, Japan

object: laboratory fault foreshocks and premonitory slip

object: chemical short-range order in CoCrNi and CrNi2 alloys

object: fractional skyrmions and bimerons in nematic liquid crystals

object: thin-film thermoelectric refrigeration modules

object: Ga-based high-entropy oxides

object: soft multistable magnetic-responsive metamaterials

object: sustainable Al alloys for laser powder bed fusion

object: flexible biomimetic block copolymer thermal sensors

object: stress inside soft materials measured by shear waves

object: Er-Fe-B dual-phase zero thermal expansion alloy

object: amorphous-amorphous transitions in silicon

mechanism_or_method: Machine-learning potential molecular dynamics with local structural analysis after rapid pressure change

object: landslide-dammed lakes and induced seismicity on the Tibetan plateau

object: active polymers made of self-propelled droplets

object: lattice metamaterials with nonreciprocal Poynting effect

object: inverse vulcanization polysulfide networks

object: humidity-sensitive photoreactive polymer color devices

object: redox-active polymeric network catalyst for reactive capture electrosynthesis

object: steel slag low-carbon cementitious material

object: photothermally actuated anisole crystals

object: light-driven liquid crystal gel strip pump

object: thermo-regulating hydrogel composite
problem: How to provide autonomous bidirectional thermal homeostasis against hot and cold environments

object: thermomagnetic generator with magnetocaloric switch
